Title: Announcing the new Azure Marketplace experience

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce a new interactive experience for the Azure Marketplace. You can now:

  • Find and deploy a product with a single click.
  • Discover products by using features such as predictive search, category and country filters, and top recommendations. 
  • Deep dive to get technical documentation, get screenshots, and decide on the right SKU list based on pricing information and publisher recommendations.
  • Get hands-on experience by clicking a test drive. 

Learn more about the new experience in our blog post. Try the new Azure Marketplace experience today.
